children.game_version: Simplified square dance game with basic walking steps.

seniors.seated_version: Perform arm and upper body gestures while seated in a square formation.
seniors.standing_version: Reduced tempo, simplified footwork without jumps.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Slowed tempo, limited range of motion.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms rounded and supple; hands held during turns
movement_profile.footwork: Jeté, chassé, croisé, plié, and arabesque
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Four couples in a square, facing the center
movement_profile.partnering: Couples perform figures together; exchange of partners occurs in some figures
movement_profile.posture: Upright, elegant carriage of the body

signature_moves.description: Ladies' chain; ladies cross the square and turn opposite gentlemen
signature_moves.name: Chaine des Dames

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid slouching; maintain the square formation

music_profile.sound_description: A structured, rhythmic sound characterized by clear, repetitive 8-measure phrases, often incorporating melodies from contemporary operas or popular songs.
music_profile.vocal_style: Instrumental, though some folk variants use a 'caller' (marcante)

teaching.level_notes: Beginners should focus on the square formation and the timing of the five figures.
